crossRefs.note: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.
Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place…
Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small…
Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds…
They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged…
But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty…
Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t…
May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be…
The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath?…
May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
For Yahweh your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t…
He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.
He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his…
They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach…
Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
For there is no partiality with God.
But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show…
You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is…
But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your…
“You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and…
You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes…
Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t…
He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands…
Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man…

translations.web: Now therefore let the fear of Yahweh be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with Yahweh our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.”
translations.bsb: And now, may the fear of the LORD be upon you. Be careful what you do, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”
translations.kjv: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
translations.asv: Now therefore let the fear of Jehovah be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with Jehovah our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.
